who: Historian of eighteenth-century France and its empire at Georgetown University; PhD Harvard, 2017.

notes: The historian authority matches both the Georgetown supervision and Harvard doctorate.

who: Historian of western Canada and Metis ethnohistory at the University of Calgary; PhD in history, University of Alberta.

evidence.says: Lists Heather Devine's 2012 research award concerning the J. X. LaRocque papers, placing her in Calgary History in the student's year.
The publisher identifies Heather Devine, author of The People Who Own Themselves, as an associate professor in Calgary's Department of History.
